files.name: FortressRelocate.java

help: After fortress TIMEOUT: walk to another seen fortress floor 16-64 blocks off, stop when a blaze shows
lesson: When a fortress run times out, retrying from the same spot repeats the timeout; the bot should first move to a different part of the fortress it has seen (or look around), then hand back to the fortress skill.
summary: fortress_relocate: right after a fortress TIMEOUT in the Nether, walks to a different seen fortress floor 16-64 blocks away and stops once a blaze is in view. If no bricks are known, it does a look-around sweep instead.
